graves.why: P is a 2-shell magazine whose basic attack fires 4-6 pellets that stack extra damage on one target, with crit changing both pellet count and per-pellet damage, and E cancels/refreshes the reload while resetting the attack timer and shaving its own cooldown per pellet landed - a specific pellet/reload state machine, not a generic ammo count. Q and R are plain casts (Q has a delayed second detonation; R's splash needs an assumption about whether the single target also eats it).
